Lifts & Trail Status

Winter 2026-27 Operations Update

Posted November 17, 2026

Opening Day of the 2026-27 winter season has been rescheduled to Thursday, November 26, weather depending. 

Learn More


Operations Update: Alpine Area Closed

Posted April 6, 2026

Alpine skiing and snowboarding are closed.

Not Permitted: Snowmobiling, ski touring and other activities, whether on foot or by motorized vehicle, are not permitted within the Sun Peaks Resort Controlled Recreation Area (CRA) at this time.

These restrictions are in place for your safety and the safety of our staff as teams continue working in these areas in preparation for winter operations.

Thank you for your cooperation.


Real-Time Lift and Alpine Trail Grooming Updates

The lift and alpine grooming trail status below updates in real time, providing the most accurate and current information. Snowcats sync directly with the website and digital on-mountain grooming boards, with updates continuing throughout the day as conditions change. Overnight grooming continues until Sun Peaks opens for the day.

A “Groomed with Fresh” status means the trail has received 5 cm or more of new snow since its last groom.

Grooming PDF

Our Daily Grooming PDF is generated once per day and published by 8:00am. Because grooming may continue after the report is generated, some trails may not be included. For the latest information, refer to the website or digital on-mountain grooming boards.
